articles.title: Govt Waives Excise Duty on Ethanol
articles.titleEn: Govt Waives Excise Duty on Ethanol
articles.summary: The government has waived excise duty on ethanol-blended petrol variants E22, E25, E27 and E30 to encourage consumers to shift to cleaner fuel, after petrol and diesel prices rose by nearly ₹7.50 a litre in late May. Learn how this tax relief fits into India’s broader fuel price and energy policy moves.
